reviews.text:
Kelly just did a renovation for us and we couldn’t be more pleased! Our pool was original to the house and had issues such as. Racks and missing tiles. It was dated and tired, it didn’t bring joy when you looked at it. Kelly came out, looked, measured and then TALKED to us! That was unusual based on the other estimates we got. He was knowledgeable and honest. He explained things he saw that would need fixing that the other estimates we got did not-including the company we use for service. The work was extremely efficient and his crews were polite, professional and worked hard. There was not a spec of sand or sliver of tile left from the demo or reno.
The renovation revealed issues that were created by the way the pool was installed 25 years ago, things like concrete not being cut a consistent depth around the perimeter and such. Kelly and his team came up with a plan and addressed those things with simple and effective solutions and he didn’t try to charge us crazy prices either. Integrity is hard to find these days, but Kelly showed it repeatedly.
We couldn’t not have asked for a better experience. The new pool is simply beautiful. It sparkles like the sun on the ocean and is such a delight to look at now. If you are considering an upgrade, or need repairs I would highly recommend Kelly and his team.
reviews.author: Jamie Uphold

reviews.text:
Friendly, professional and flexible.  Very competitive, but accurate bids.
Had an issue with my pool light, pool coating failure, spa tile and the surround mastic.
Price quoted with several add in option possibilities.  In the end, Kelly reduced some items that cost less than the quote and we replaced with some needed add on repairs.  Final cost was actually a little less than the original quote.
Each crew that came out was very efficient, and did a great cleanup each time.
You don’t have to be there to make sure they are doing the job right!
I attached images that will tell the story better than this review.
Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Brent Campbell

reviews.text: Couldn't be more pleased! I got four estimates, and Kelly's was the only one I didn't have to correct. He responded quickly, addressed my questions, and followed through every step of the way. The crew was mindful of the yard and cleaned up at the end of every work day. They weren't just craftsmen, they were true artisans. The stonework and tile are beautiful. Competitive price, great communication, and beautiful final product. Would definitely recommend whether for service, maintenance or complete renovation.
reviews.author: Dennis Gore

reviews.text: I took my time in getting bids for having my pool renovation done. I got 12 different estimates over a two month period. Do your research!! I came to realize that most of these companies don't even carry insurance. No homeowner should ever allow those people on your property. It only took me about ten minutes to decide that Kelly was the kind of person and company that I had been looking for. His bid was competitive, but his experience is the most valuable aspect of the job. His crews did a great job, cleaned up very well, and did the whole thing like it was a pleasure. Couldn't have been a better experience. I wholeheartedly recommend  this company!!
reviews.author: Vaughn C

reviews.text: Kelly’s has been doing our maintenance and repairs for years and when our pool needed a renovation, we didn’t consider anyone else. They also completed 2 stone deck areas at the same time. Everything they did turned out awesome! Kelly’s is by far the best around. You can’t go wrong!
reviews.author: Kerrie Dwyer

reviews.text: This is the first time I’ve used Kelly’s Pool Care and I was very impressed. My pool equipment is 25 years old. I had some equipment that didn’t work, some leaky valves, and some that worked (barely but still worked). Kelly inspected the equipment and explained what he could fix and what would have to be replaced. I would have easily believed that all of it would have to be replaced. His approach in repairing equipment versus when to replace it is very reasonable. Not only did this approach reduce the amount of replacement equipment that I would need at this time but his prices are very fair. They did what they said they would, they were responsive and everything works perfectly. My experience showed me a fair and trustworthy pool company that I will use again. Hey, it’s a swimming pool, it will break again :)
reviews.author: Mike Curtis

reviews.text: My pool needed to be replastered and a tile upgrade and new mastic. I contacted three pool services. Kelly's wasn't the lowest but it wasn't the highest. He came over, gave me an estimate on the pool and was very satisfied with the estimate. They started on a Tuesday and completely done by Friday . The communication was fantastic. His knowledge of pools is outstanding.  Very helpful. I would definitely recommend Kelly's Pool service for any of your pool needs. He'll be getting more work from me for sure. Thanks Kelly!
reviews.author: Mary Ann

reviews.text: My pool & deck needed refurbushing. I used Kelly’s for the pool project. Knowledgeable, friendly & cooperative when it comes to coordinating a project. I was so impressed Kellys now does my weekly/monthly maintenance. His team is awesome. Thanks!
reviews.author: Mike Frenzel

Mention of crew behavior and cleanup
Varied writing styles and specific customer names
